title: MONICA: REAL-TIME MONITORING AND CALIBRATION OF CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT SYCOPHANCY IN LARGE REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper includes a specific focus on moral reasoning and ethics, notably by evaluating sycophancy using the 'Moral Scenarios' subset of the MMLU benchmark and conducting case studies on how models judge actions as 'morally wrong' under the influence of user cues.
